description.text: The first enhanced expansion pack of the Scarlet & Violet series, released on 10 March 2023 and made for sealed play, in which decks are built only from packs opened on the spot. The final forms of the three Paldea starter Pokémon lead it as Pokémon ex: Meowscarada ex, Skeledirge ex and Quaquaval ex. Paldean Clodsire ex, Lycanroc ex and the Tera Pokémon Dedenne ex join them, with the Academy's teacher Dendra and its director Clavell as Supporters for the first time, and Art Rare cards of Sprigatito, Fuecoco and Quaxly. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 73, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and gold Ultra Rare Meowscarada ex, Skeledirge ex and Quaquaval ex. In English its cards were split: some came out in Paldea Evolved in June 2023 and others in Obsidian Flames in August 2023.
